title: spergularia rubra subsp. atheniensis
intro: Spergularia rubra subsp. atheniensis, commonly known as Athen's spurgling or red sand-spurrey, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia rubra subsp. atheniensis are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among others. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential source of natural remedies.
